description: Wait until a matching email arrives in an inbox and return it in full (text, detected codes, links). Without "since", returns the newest unread matching email, so repeated calls return successive emails.

from.description: Only match senders containing this text.

since.description: ISO timestamp — only match emails received after it (read or unread).

subject.description: Only match subjects containing this text.

name: wait_for_email
title: Wait for email
